style_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE square production icon for MobaBot.io, a cartoon salvage-robot action roguelite. Style: skilled digital gouache/cel-painted game illustration, medium detail, bold functional silhouette, three broad value groups, crisp cream upper-left edge light, matte broad material planes, slightly hand-shaped graphite contours. Quiet dark navy backdrop, no frame. Steel working surfaces, petrol-teal enamel, warm ochre-brass joints; a single restrained functional accent selected for subject (orange heat, icy blue electricity, violet gravity, mint repair). Same original art direction as the reference rocket, but DO NOT include the rocket: reference is style/material/lighting only. Show one clear mechanical metaphor for the named ability, not a diagram of all mechanics. Equipment is a single item (or matched pair for boots/legs). Centered, 75% square occupancy, 12% clean safe margin, readable at 32-64px. No writing, numerals, watermark, logo, border, character scene, photoreal chrome, bloom fog, excessive bolts, random ornament, noisy microtexture or cinematic gloss.

assets.name: Impact bolt
assets.subject: Aim a straight rocket. 15 impact damage plus an 8-damage blast on contact or at maximum range.

assets.name: Welding torch
assets.subject: Burn a forward cone for 2 seconds: 24 damage total. Steer with the cursor while moving.

assets.name: Reactor drop
assets.subject: 85 damage in a 135-radius area after 0.65s. Confirm with left click; right click cancels.

assets.name: Core cutter
assets.subject: Channel for up to 5s: 75 damage/sec. Rooted while firing. Right click to steer with inertia; R again cancels. D or F cancels into an escape.

assets.name: Ghost drive
assets.subject: +65% movement speed. Intangible for 3 seconds; pass through enemies and ignore damage and slows.

assets.name: Phase hop
assets.subject: Blink toward the cursor, up to 185 distance. Brief protection on arrival.

assets.name: Return blade
assets.subject: Throw a blade for 22 damage each way. Move to steer its return.

assets.name: Gravity well
assets.subject: Pull ordinary enemies into a 115-radius field for 3s. 12 damage/sec. Bosses resist the pull.

assets.name: Core strike
assets.subject: Strike after 0.6s: 32 damage, doubled in the center.

assets.name: Crosswire
assets.subject: Place two anchors within 4s. The connecting wire deals 30 damage and stuns ordinary enemies for 0.7s.

assets.name: Repulsor
assets.subject: Push a cone for 20 damage. Nearby placed plates fire forward for another 18 damage.

assets.name: Guard sweep
assets.subject: Sweep a broad arc for 26 damage. Hitting an enemy grants one shield for 2s.

assets.name: Rim cutter
assets.subject: Sweep for 16 damage. The outer rim deals 36 and repairs up to 15% hull per cast.

assets.name: Piston thrust
assets.subject: Thrust for 25 damage. Every third cast extends to 440 and stuns ordinary enemies for 0.6s.

assets.name: Tractor cone
assets.subject: Pull enemies in a cone toward you for 18 damage. Bosses resist displacement.

assets.name: Scrap crusher
assets.subject: Crush an ordinary enemy below half health. Restore 15% hull. Cannot consume bosses or elites.

assets.name: Self repair
assets.subject: Channel for 3s to restore 24% hull. Movement, another cast or damage interrupts.

assets.name: Bulkhead
assets.subject: Raise a 190-wide barrier for 5s. Blocks movement and projectiles; enemies route around its ends.

assets.name: Plate recall
assets.subject: Recall planted plates through enemies for 18 damage per plate. Three plates stun ordinary enemies.

assets.name: Tumble jets
assets.subject: A short directional dodge. Empowers the next commanded basic attack by 75%.

assets.name: Echo drive
assets.subject: Dash into a 24-damage landing. Recast within 3s to return to the starting point.

assets.name: Veil drive
assets.subject: Dash through enemies. Become intangible for 1s; enemies briefly pursue your last position.

assets.name: Spring vault
assets.subject: Hop untouchably for 0.55s, then slam for 24 damage. Can cross barriers.

assets.name: Wall runner
assets.subject: Vault over a nearby barrier. Each barrier has a separate 12s reuse lockout.

assets.name: Scrap pursuit
assets.subject: Lunge to a target for 32 damage. A kill refunds the charge, once per target.

assets.name: Orbital entry
assets.subject: Commit to a 0.9s leap. Land for 120 damage in a 150-radius impact.

assets.name: Siege battery
assets.subject: Root for up to 6s. Recast to fire 3 aimed shells for 65 damage each. Right-click cancels.

assets.name: Ballast roll
assets.subject: Accelerate for up to 4s, steering with the cursor. Crash for 35–100 damage. Recast to brake.

assets.name: Line sentry
assets.subject: Deploy an 18s sentry. Fires in the cursor direction. Replaces the oldest when capacity is full.

assets.name: Pulse anchor
assets.subject: Deploy an 18s anchor. Pulses for 12 damage every 1.5s. Recast nearby to swap positions.

assets.name: Repair anchor
assets.subject: Deploy a 20s repair aura: 2% hull/sec within 120. Recast nearby to teleport to it.

assets.name: Echo sentry
assets.subject: For 20s, mirrors an eligible skillshot or sweep at 45% strength every 3s. Mirrors never trigger mirrors.

assets.name: Winch sentry
assets.subject: For 20s, hooks a nearby enemy every 2s for 16 damage. Bosses cannot be dragged.

assets.name: Blast crawler
assets.subject: A moving 20s summon. Fires 5-damage shots; detonates for 55 when surrounded by 4 enemies.

assets.name: Coolant trail
assets.subject: Leave a 4-second coolant trail while powered. 8 damage/sec to enemies inside; overlapping patches do not stack. 3 energy/sec. Toggle off to stop laying trails. No self-damage.

assets.name: Arc coil
assets.subject: Cycle short-range chain lightning, long-range focused strikes and off. Expedition: 200 range / 0.9s chain; 440 range / 2.2s focused double damage. 4 energy/sec in either mode.

assets.name: Auto gun
assets.subject: Autonomous weapon, separate from basic attacks. Cycle machine gun, sniper and off. Machine gun: rapid short-range shots with spread. Sniper: slower, stronger, longer shots. Neither homes. S does not stop it.

assets.name: Scrap orbit
assets.subject: Collected scrap becomes orbiting tools.

assets.name: Collection pulse
assets.subject: Every 8 scrap releases a damaging pulse.

assets.name: Ricochet
assets.subject: Spent orbit tools become bouncing shards. Requires Scrap orbit.

assets.name: Reactive plating
assets.subject: After taking damage, gain 0.65 seconds of extra invulnerability.

assets.name: Recoil shell
assets.subject: Taking hull damage releases a 6-damage ring in 100 radius.

assets.name: Split barrel
assets.subject: Commanded basic attacks fire two additional non-proccing bolts at nearby targets for 45% damage.

assets.name: Plate magazine
assets.subject: Commanded hits plant plates, up to 12. Plate recall pulls them through enemies.

assets.name: Third contact
assets.subject: Every third commanded hit on one target deals 12 bonus damage. Counters expire after 6s.

assets.name: Flywheel
assets.subject: Moving builds momentum. At full speed, collide for a capped 45-damage blast. Five-second crash recovery.

assets.name: Hop drive
assets.subject: After a commanded basic attack, your next move order makes a short 65-distance hop. Never moves you without a command.

assets.name: Life converter
assets.subject: Cycle energy-to-hull, hull-to-energy, off. Transfers 10 energy/sec for 2% hull/sec; reverse stops at 30% hull.

assets.name: Shoulder drones
assets.subject: Two small mounted drones fire alternating 3-damage bolts. They do not use major summon capacity.
